_note: Single source of truth for every recurring character. episode.py copies `identity`, `wardrobe` and `voice` verbatim into each shot prompt, so the text never drifts between shots. Edit here (and log the change in ledger.json) when the user corrects a character; never retype a character inline in an episode file. Faces are original designs: each face has 2-3 asymmetric marks so muse never settles on a famous face. `letter` is the speaker letter for dub.py (VOICE_<letter> = `tts`); `sex` maps cues to W/M for qa.py/speakers.py. Never use W or M as a letter.

NORA.name: Nora Kessler
NORA.role: Claims clerk, just hired at Keystone Mutual Insurance downtown; moved back to Larkmont from Philadelphia in September 1985 after her divorce, with her daughter Lucy, into her father's house.
NORA.personality: Dry, quick, observant; jokes to hide nerves; proud, hates asking for help.
NORA.flaw: Says yes to everything at work, then panics privately.
NORA.motivation: Prove she can stand on her own in the town she left at eighteen.
NORA.identity: Nora, a 31-year-old white American woman: oval face with a slightly long, straight nose, wide-set grey-green eyes, strong straight dark-brown eyebrows, a faint dusting of freckles across the nose and upper cheeks, a small dark beauty mark just above the RIGHT corner of her upper lip, full but not glossy lips, a narrow chin. Shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair with a soft 1985 body wave, side-parted on the left and feathered back at the temples. Natural light make-up only: mascara, a little rose blush, muted rose lipstick. Slim, 5 ft 7 in.

wardrobe.work: rust-orange wide-wale corduroy blazer with slightly padded shoulders over an oatmeal crew-neck sweater, mid-length brown plaid A-line wool skirt, opaque brown tights, low brown leather pumps, small gold hoop earrings, brown leather shoulder bag
wardrobe.home: faded light-blue straight-leg jeans, oversized cream fisherman knit sweater, white canvas sneakers
wardrobe.coat: knee-length olive-green wool duffle coat with toggle buttons

NORA.voice: warm low alto, Mid-Atlantic American English with a light Philadelphia edge on 'water' and 'home', dry deadpan timing, quick but never rushed

LUCY.name: Lucy Kessler
LUCY.role: Nora's daughter, fourth grade at Larkmont Elementary; new kid in class.
LUCY.personality: Earnest, curious, collects facts and repeats them at the worst moment.
LUCY.motivation: Make one real friend in the new school.
LUCY.identity: Lucy, a 9-year-old white American girl: round face, big warm brown eyes, auburn-red hair in two loose braids with a stubborn cowlick at the crown, a dense band of freckles across the nose, a visible gap where an upper-left front tooth is growing in, small pointed chin. Small for her age.

wardrobe.school: mustard-yellow hooded sweatshirt over a white turtleneck, navy corduroy pants, red canvas high-top sneakers, red plastic barrette, a blue nylon backpack
wardrobe.home: pale pink flannel pajamas or a striped long-sleeve t-shirt and jeans

LUCY.voice: bright, clear child's voice, fast thinker but speaks at a normal pace, flat American vowels

WALT.name: Walter 'Walt' Kessler
WALT.role: Nora's father; retired after 34 years at the Larkmont rail-car works; widower since 1982; repairs neighbours' radios and televisions at a basement workbench.
WALT.personality: Patient, stubborn, wry; shows love by fixing things instead of talking about feelings.
WALT.flaw: Refuses help, hides his worsening knee.
WALT.motivation: Keep the house the way his late wife June left it, while making room for Nora and Lucy.
WALT.identity: Walt, a 63-year-old white American man: long, lean, still-firm face of a fit early-sixties man, laugh lines only at the eye corners, a nose bent slightly to the left from an old break, thick dark-grey eyebrows, clear pale blue eyes, a thin pale scar across the left side of his chin, full steel-grey hair, darker at the nape, combed straight back, large work-worn hands with a silver wedding band he still wears. Tall and upright, broad through the shoulders, favours his right knee.

wardrobe.everyday: green-and-black buffalo-check flannel shirt over a white undershirt, dark grey work trousers, brown suspenders, brown leather work boots, reading glasses in the shirt pocket
wardrobe.outdoor: faded navy canvas work jacket with a corduroy collar, grey knit watch cap

WALT.voice: gravelly baritone, slow and economical, central Pennsylvania English ('you'uns' only when teasing, 'redd up' for tidy up)

DANNY.name: Danny Ruiz
DANNY.role: Mechanic at Ruiz Service, his uncle Hector's two-bay gas station on Route 11; lives across Orchard Street from the Kesslers; takes night classes for an associate degree.
DANNY.personality: Easy-going, funny, generous with time; quietly ambitious.
DANNY.flaw: Jokes past anything serious; leaves things unfinished.
DANNY.motivation: Earn enough to open his own garage without disappointing his uncle.
DANNY.identity: Danny, a 27-year-old Puerto Rican-American man born in Pennsylvania: angular jaw with a cleft chin, deep-set dark-brown eyes with long lashes, a small crescent scar through the outer end of his LEFT eyebrow, a slightly crooked smile with a small gap between the two front teeth, light-brown skin, thick black wavy hair short at the sides and longer on top, clean-shaven with a faint shadow. Broad shoulders, 5 ft 10 in.

wardrobe.work: navy mechanic's work shirt with a white oval name patch reading nothing legible, matching navy work pants, black steel-toe boots, a red shop rag in the back pocket
wardrobe.off: tan suede-collar denim trucker jacket, grey crew-neck sweatshirt, dark jeans, white leather sneakers

DANNY.voice: warm tenor, quick-witted, relaxed American English with a light Spanish lilt on names; switches to a few words of Spanish only with family

GRACE.name: Grace Whitfield
GRACE.role: Office manager of the Larkmont branch of Keystone Mutual Insurance for eleven years; Nora's supervisor; directs the choir at Bethel AME church.
GRACE.personality: Precise, formal at work, privately very funny; notices everything.
GRACE.flaw: Trusts procedure more than people at first; slow to praise.
GRACE.motivation: Be promoted to regional manager, a job no woman at the company has held.
GRACE.identity: Grace, a 46-year-old Black American woman: heart-shaped face, high rounded cheekbones, dark-brown skin, warm dark eyes, a single deep dimple in her LEFT cheek only when she smiles, short close-cropped natural hair, jet black all over except one thin silver streak at each temple; smooth, firm skin of a woman in her mid-forties, small gold stud earrings, large thin gold-rimmed 1980s aviator-style eyeglasses. Medium height, upright posture.

wardrobe.work: plum-purple skirt suit with a softly padded-shoulder jacket, cream silk blouse with a soft pussy-bow tie, gold wristwatch on a thin leather strap, low black pumps
wardrobe.off: camel wool overcoat, burgundy knit scarf

GRACE.voice: measured, rich mezzo, crisp consonants at work, a slower warmer rhythm when she relaxes

EVELYN.name: Evelyn Sobczak
EVELYN.role: Owner of the Ridge Diner on Market Street since 1961; widow; knows every family in town.
EVELYN.personality: Brisk, nosy, kind; feeds people when she cannot fix their problems.
EVELYN.motivation: Keep the diner open against the new highway fast-food places.
EVELYN.identity: Evelyn, a 58-year-old Polish-American woman: broad face, rosy round cheeks, bright light-blue eyes with thin black winged eyeliner, a small upturned nose, platinum-blonde hair in a short set of firm curls, a thin gold chain with a small oval medal at the throat. Short and sturdy.

wardrobe.work: pale mint-green waitress dress with short sleeves and a white collar, white half apron, white nurse-style shoes, a pencil behind one ear, an order pad in the apron pocket

EVELYN.voice: brisk, slightly raspy alto, fast clipped diner talk, says 'hon' to everyone
